summary.decision_summary: Bend & Snap Count won by 91.0. Bend & Snap Count left 16.5 lineup points on the table, while Squat left 13.7.
summary.historical_summary: Bend & Snap Count is 11-6 against Squat across 17 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Bend & Snap Count
summary.winner_reason: Bend & Snap Count won by 91.0, led by a 52.0-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Bucky Irving (36.5) and Jaylen Warren (35.8).
summary.loser_reason: Squat could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 52.0 points. Tyler Shough scored -0.8. A best legal lineup added 13.7, still short of the 91.0-point margin.
